title: BNPL Platinum: How to Activate 6-Month Financing on Your Account
summary: This document explains how to activate BNPL Platinum 6‑month financing in your account (Settings > Financing > BNPL Platinum > Activate 6‑Month Financing, review terms, confirm). Activation is complete only when the BNPL Platinum status flag shows “[value not available] = true,” with troubleshooting steps if it doesn’t update.
